overview.lead: Your primary resonance is {primary}, harmonized by the {secondary} frequency.
paragraphs: Your attachment blueprint is a living map for exploring the exquisite architecture of intimacy, autonomy, and security. This is not mere theory. It is the result of tracking the internal tides of your body—the subtle shifts in pulse, the unconscious contraction of breath, and the loops of thought that arise when connection feels vulnerable. By illuminating these patterns, we transform reactive instincts into a refined language for your most cherished bonds.

The fusion of your primary and secondary types shows that your relational soul is fluid, not fixed. Even if one pattern is the dominant guardian, within you lies a constellation of auxiliary instincts that can provide a steadier rhythm through the clarity of structure or the grace of gentle distancing. When you consciously orchestrate these diverse aspects of yourself, you can serve as a profound example to your partner of what it means to heal without the weight of blame.

This profile also serves as a gentle sentry, capturing the 'caution signals' of your nervous system: the shadow of anxiety that seeps in when a message goes unanswered, the mental walls built behind a whispered misunderstanding, or the numbness that masks a longing for deep recognition. By recognizing these moments early, you can apply sacred scripts and grounding rituals before old autopilots take command.

Reflect on how these essential strengths can adapt from the intense heat of romantic union to the vast landscapes of family, friendship, and the professional realm. A stable anchor allows you to accept love not as a debt to be repaid, but as a natural birthright, and an evolved instinct will become a safe laboratory for testing more vibrant ways of being.

This insight is an invitation to make a new covenant with your own body. By integrating nervous system regulation strategies, you remind your nervous system that it is safe to absorb care at a sustainable pace. True alchemy happens not when the head understands an abstract concept, but when the body experiences safety as a practical sensation.

Finally, remember that you do not walk this path alone. This blueprint is a tool for connection. Invite trusted counselors, mentors, or loved ones into your experiment of finding truth. Attachment patterns were born in the presence of others, and they can only be transformed and transcended within the sacred space of relationship.

actionPlan.title: 4-Week Action Plan
actionPlan.description: Try one thing a week. No pressure. If you miss a day, it's fine—the point is just to start.

steps.title: Week 1: Track your patterns
steps.description: Pick one recent moment where you felt uncomfortable in a relationship. Write down what you thought and felt. Just realizing 'Oh, this is how I react' is half the battle.

steps.title: Week 2: Speak up directly
steps.description: Stop hinting or holding it in. Try saying, 'When you do X, I feel Y. I'd appreciate it if you did Z.' Practice with someone low-stakes first; it doesn't have to be perfect.

steps.title: Week 3: Build a calm-down routine
steps.description: Pick one way to soothe yourself (deep breathing, a walk, reading your notes) when you feel anxious or avoidant. Repeat it until your body learns you're safe.

steps.title: Week 4: Repair after a bump
steps.description: After a conflict, don't run away. Try to reconnect by saying, 'I'm sorry about how I acted earlier.' Relationships aren't about never fighting; they're about how you recover.

secure.summary: You embody the Archetype of the Anchor. You perceive intimacy and autonomy as two halves of a whole, expecting relationships to be collaborative, resilient, and based on fundamental honesty.
strengths: Clearly express the subtle nuances of your inner world without exaggeration or minimization.
Possess an unwavering belief that disagreements can be resolved.
Offer reassurance abundantly and receive it with a graceful heart.
A master of 'rapid repair,' tending to flaws before they become wounds.
Communicate needs at dawn before they sink into the twilight of resentment.
growth: Just because you're stable doesn't mean your partner knows what you're thinking. Be specific about what kind of support you need.
Check if you're taking on too much just to avoid disappointing others. It's healthy to say 'I can't do that' sometimes.
Before you jump to fix a problem, remember that just being there is often enough.
The more comfortable a relationship is, the easier it is to get lazy. Say 'thank you' and 'I love you' out loud often.
relationship: Act as a model of 'transparent validation' to provide a sanctuary for less stable companions.
Share the routines that anchor your soul, so others may borrow your tranquility amidst the storm.
Sacredly regard 'healthy interdependence,' remembering that being supported is a strength, not a weakness.
Utilize your anchored voice to propose collaborative boundary setting.
regulation: When a conversation intensifies, slow your breath and precisely lengthen the duration of your exhale.
Name your physical sensations to stay integrated with the body's truth as it joins with the mind's logic.
Remind yourself: 'I can stay fully present here without surrendering my own sanctuary.'

anxiousPreoccupied.summary: You are the Archetype of the Yearner. Your sensitivity to the tides of connection is profound, often interpreting others' silence as a call to navigate closer to the shores of reassurance.
strengths: Possess a refined intuition that captures the inner shifts of those you love.
Dedicatedly guard the flame of connection, pouring immense energy into bridging any estrangement.
A source of fundamental affirmation and tireless exploration of others' inner worlds.
Cherish an immortal hope for the power of repair, no matter how long the night.
Deep capacity for intimacy that seeks to leave no one behind in the cold.
growth: When they're slow to reply, write down 'they're probably busy' and do something else for 30 minutes before you spiral. It's usually nothing.
Stop hinting and ask directly. Say, 'I'm feeling anxious, can you tell me everything is okay?' They can't read your mind.
Keep a list of 'proof' that they care about you. Read it when you feel anxious to calm your brain down.
Don't sit there stewing. Get moving. Don't wait for the perfect moment—just send a text or start a task to break the cycle of overthinking.
relationship: Establish shared rhythms of connection to clear the fog of waiting and doubt.
Present your sensitivity as a rare treasure, so companions may regard its value as sacred.
Co-orchestrate plans for reunion after time apart.
regulation: Invoke the 4-6 breath rhythm to lower the urgency of your pulse before speaking truth.
Reassure your physical self with a 'self-touch' ritual—placing a hand on your heart or gently cradling your cheek.
Repeat the mantra: 'Affection only pauses; it does not vanish. I am sustained even in silence.'

dismissiveAvoidant.summary: You are the Archetype of the Sovereign. Independence is your sublime sanctuary. You find safety within your vast inner landscape when the emotional atmosphere becomes heavy.
strengths: A flag-bearer who remains unfazed in moments of crisis, designing paths for practical progress.
Deep respect for the sanctity of personal space and the autonomy of the soul.
Move with graceful self-credit, or at least do not burden others with the weight of your needs.
Capable of refining complex inner tides into clear language once trust is established.
growth: Stop using logic to bury your feelings. Before you brush things off with 'I'm fine,' try saying, 'Actually, that hurt my feelings.'
Practice asking for small favors before you try to handle everything alone. Letting people help is part of a relationship.
When you need space, don't just vanish. Say, 'I need some time to think, let's talk later.'
When you get feedback, don't get defensive or run away. Just say, 'I hear you,' and sit with it for a second.
relationship: Clearly explain your specific topography of intimacy so companions do not rely on guesswork.
Design connection rituals with a higher purpose—shared creation, pilgrimage, or a common vision.
Always provide a 'promise of return' when needing solitary time, stating the reason and when you will be back.
Offer gifts of spoken praise. Unexpressed gratitude is like a lamp that is never lit.
regulation: Gently relax the armor in your shoulders and the tension in your jaw before engaging in difficult dialogue.
Anchor in truth: 'I can remain fully in the presence of others while maintaining the boundaries of my soul.'
Use 'bilateral stimulation'—alternately tapping your thighs—to stay present in the here and now.

fearfulAvoidant.summary: You are the Archetype of the Voyager. Your heart navigates a swirling sea where longing for union meets the harsh fear of betrayal, performing a complex and rhythmical dance of presence and retreat.
strengths: Possess a crystalline intuition, sensing even the slightest shifts in the relational atmosphere.
Capable revealing very deep levels of vulnerability once safety is secured.
An alchemist dedicated to healing ancient patterns that no longer serve your evolution.
Capable of witnessing and honoring multifaceted truths simultaneously.
growth: Identify what triggers your urge to run and write down a 'pause' phrase to read when it happens.
Before you end a relationship out of fear, ask: 'I'm scared right now, can I check if this is actually true?'
You don't need to open up to everyone. Focus on distinguishing who is safe and who needs boundaries.
Don't wait until you're perfectly ready to reach out. Even a clumsy first step is better than staying still.
relationship: Illuminate and explain the complex push-and-pull of emotions occurring within you for your partner.
Utilize shared calendars or unchanging routines as reliable anchors to build trust.
Establish a collective safety plan—timeouts during conflict, stabilization phrases, etc.
Seek professionals or communities who can witness and support your growth.
regulation: Use stabilization techniques that combine breath, movement, and sensory input when anxiety surges.
Repeat the mantra: 'I am afraid, but I can stay here. I can leave for a moment and then return.'
Practice 'orienting toward truth' by finding and naming 5 objects around you to return to the present.

earnedSecure.summary: You are the Archetype of the Alchemist. Through rigorous self-witnessing, you have designed a foundation of safety from within. Ancient echoes are still heard, but you now hold the key to a new and vibrant resonance.
strengths: Gently weave insights gained from reflection into the fabric of daily interactions.
Act as a compassionate mentor, guiding others through the landscape of vulnerability based on inherited wisdom.
Sacredly guard the boundaries of the self without severing the links of connection with others.
Maintain your needs as sacred while gracefully taking responsibility for your impact on others.
growth: Update your coping strategies as your situation changes. What worked before might not fit now.
Don't just look at the next goal—give yourself credit for how far you've already come.
Attachment work isn't just about handling crises; it's also about learning how to have fun together.
Your growth sets an example for those around you. Share what you've learned.
relationship: Co-design connection rituals to strengthen the secure base you are building.
Share the methods that transformed you—journaling, psychological terminology, recovery loops, etc.—with loved ones.
Grant yourself the same infinite mercy you bestow upon others.
regulation: Harmonize body and mind by combining breath and movement.
Invoke the affirmation: 'I am creating safety for myself, and I deserve it.'
Honor your wholeness by taking regular time for nervous system care.

items.question: Can this inquiry replace the wisdom of healers?
items.answer: No. This is a reflective tool designed to illuminate your journey alongside certified therapists or spiritual guides.

items.question: Is the geometry of my attachment fixed forever?
items.answer: Not at all. Through intentional witnessing and consistent practice of repair, the soul's resonance anchors and becomes more secure over cycles of time.

items.question: How can I best leverage these revelations?
items.answer: Begin with one ritual, one new script, or one subtle shift in the nervous system each week. Invite your community into your victories, so healing becomes a collective masterpiece.
